title: Confidentiality position (triodian.bd.confidentiality.v1)
description: The board's position on which classes of information (G1 to G6) may go into which kinds of AI tool (K1 to K7): P permitted, C with conditions, N not permitted. Exported by AI Board Direction (board-direction public/bd-outputs.js, the Confidentiality position file); imported by the AI Confidentiality Exposure Assessment (public/cea-rules.js readBoardPosition()), which suggests a required rung on each channel for counsel to confirm. It carries no inventory lines and no names.

status.description: draft until the chair records the board's resolution

markings.description: Class:kind to P, C or N
